T: Pros on strike. Everyday guys get to play.
D: When the pros go on strike, a washed-up college quarterback and a team of scabs get four games to save the Washington Sentinels' season.
P: Serve the sundae when Falco hits Murphy for the winning touchdown.
S: Hot cheese queso with corn chips. Falco says his fear is quicksand.

Toss the cheeses with the cornflour. Soften the onion and jalapenos in the butter with the cumin. Add the evaporated milk and bring to a simmer, then stir in the cheese a handful at a time until smooth. Stir in the tomato and serve hot with the corn chips.
Welsh rarebit on toast. Nigel kicks a 65-yard field goal.

Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick. Take off the heat and beat in the cheddar, mustard and egg yolk. Toast the bread, spread thickly with the cheese and grill until bubbling and spotted brown. Dust with paprika and cut into fingers.
M: Chilli dogs with onions. Franklin fears going back to the mini-mart.

Brown the mince with the diced onion, add the spices and passata and simmer until thick. Grill the franks, turning, until blistered. Toast the rolls, add a frank and smother with chilli. Top with cheese, raw onion and mustard.
1 brown onion, finely diced, plus 1 for topping@Produce
Grilled swordfish rolls with lemon caper mayo. McGinty finds Falco on his houseboat.

Mix the mayo with the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and the capers. Rub the swordfish with oil and Old Bay and grill on a very hot pan 2 to 3 minutes a side. Toast the rolls and spread with the lemon mayo. Fill with lettuce, tomato and thick slices of swordfish.
W: Warm brownie sundae. Murphy catches the winner as time expires: glory lasts forever.

Melt the dark chocolate and butter, then beat in the sugar and eggs and fold in the flour and cocoa. Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170C until just set with a fudgy middle. Heat the cream and pour over the milk chocolate, stirring until smooth. Serve warm brownie squares with ice cream, hot fudge and peanuts.
K: Cold lager with a whisky shot. The scabs brawl with Martel at the bar.
Pour the lager into 4 chilled glasses. Pour a 30ml shot of bourbon for each and serve alongside.
